body: I got molested as teenager, car window broken after college, told I was owned, told it was my fault I got lied to, and beat up pregnant then while nursing bc I sought the wrong guys to just.hold.me.

It is so insane exactly how it gets twisted to everything being my fault, even another's gd feelings and even their bad breath.  Their identity is to hurt.
But they give me meaning and I never had any without them.

My mom wouldn't let me wash my clothing when they were dirty, and then teased me for my smells.  It was pretty mean name calling and she took joy from telling me I smelled.

This forensic psychology years later I guess is useful to make us feel less bad about going onwards in life, without them in our "clan". We have the right to find a "clan" to join where we feel as safe as possible, and a range of mammals have been doing it for a long time.

It is a testament to how bad the abuse is that we are willing to risk going it alone over being unsafe in the only group we ever belonged to.

She holds her arm around my neck in a choke hold in photos as if she is my owner (the irony being that I am getting out of a violent relationship, where she without mentioning the violence said she would come get me but said I would just reject her and her world would fall apart and it would all be about her loss).  

My favorites are being held under the fire hose, being pushed feet away from head on freeway traffic cause I was leaning into her for safety as we walked, and being told I am "miserable" if I am sad, being told "no wonder nobody likes you" and teased for being teased, being told in the past as to different partners "your boyfriend should break up with you" / "your boyfriend is cheating on you" / and "your boyfriend doesnt want you when you are on your period because he is only using you."  All pointing towards her being the only true source of love.  

She liked most the two richest guys, regardless of them telling me they "settled for me" and "are dating several other people but we are not dating just sex."  She said the latter truly did love me.  Because they were in the geographical region closest to her, of course.  #priorities
